text: Several visitors reported difficulty finding the library due to incorrect or misleading location information on maps, which sometimes directed them to remote farmland. Some reviewers expressed frustration with customer service, particularly around ticket changes and the lack of responsive staff. There were also concerns about the gift shop’s merchandise, which many felt did not represent local North Dakota artists, and criticism of the use of AI in exhibits. On the positive side, the building’s architecture and the surrounding landscape received frequent mention, as did the interactive exhibits and the kindness of staff. However, a few visitors noted issues with food quality and crowding during their visits.
